items.title: 'If we play good cricket, why not?': Litton backs Tigers to go all the way in tri-series
items.summary: “If we play good cricket, why not?” Newly appointed ODI captain Litton Das fell back on the age-old wisdom that Bangladesh players so often reach for in press conferences when asked to predict positive outcomes. In this case, the question was whether Bangladesh could go all the way and become champions in the tri-nation series against Zimbabwe and Afghanistan.

items.title: Tigers back in tri-series business, with World Cup in mind
items.summary: The Tigers’ record in tri-series suggests that winning the tournament will be no simple task. They have claimed just one title in 13 attempts, while losing to Sri Lanka in the finals of 2009 and 2018.

items.title: U-19 Tigers’ Afghanistan series rescheduled again
items.summary: The series was initially scheduled to comprise five matches, starting on October 13, but was reduced to four after the Bangladesh team failed to obtain Oman visas on time.

items.title: Mosaddek draws inspiration from 2019 tri-series heroics
items.summary: Mosaddek Hossain was the hero of Bangladesh’s last and only multi-nation tournament triumph, when the Tigers won the Ireland tri-nation series, also featuring the West Indies, in 2019. The batter now hopes to draw inspiration from that triumph and replicate his heroics in the upcoming tri-nation series in Abu Dhabi, starting on October 17.
